
# Install Necessary Packages - Only required the first time

install.packages(c(
  "broom",
  "car",
  "caret",
  "MASS",
  "glmnet",
  "lmtest", 
  "ggplot2", 
  "remotes"
))

remove.packages("rlang")
install.packages("rlang")


# Load packages into your R environment 

library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(ggplot2)
library(lmtest)
library(car)
library(caret)
library(MASS)
library(glmnet)
library(remotes)
library(rlang)


#Load Insurance Data Set
insurance <- read.csv('Data/insurance.csv')

# Print the first few rows
head(insurance)

# Print the last few rows
tail(insurance)

# Summary statistics
summary(insurance)

# Display the type of each variable
str(insurance)

#Plot the graph of bmi against charges highlighting smokers and non smokers

ggplot(insurance, aes(x = bmi, y = charges , color = smoker )) + geom_point()
